Home > Services > Guardianships

Protect someone who needs support.

When an individual is unable to make certain personal, medical, or financial decisions independently, a guardianship may provide the legal authority necessary for another person to act on their behalf.

At a glance

  • Guardianship petitions
  • Personal decisions
  • Property and finances
  • Court reporting
Request a consultation →

About this service

This service might be right for you if:

  • Someone needs support with personal, medical or financial decisions.
  • You need to understand whether a less restrictive alternative is available.
  • You are considering a guardianship petition.
  • You need help understanding responsibilities after appointment.

What we cover

What guardianship support includes

Guardianship petitions
Guidance on petitions and appointment proceedings.
Personal decisions
Guardianship relating to healthcare, care and living arrangements.
Property and finances
Guidance on managing assets, income, expenses and financial matters.
Ongoing responsibilities
Help with court filings, reporting, records and fiduciary obligations.
